harness.decision: Single capability, not an orchestration harness

gates.G1: Automatic bounded byte/contract checks; rights/accessibility outside promise
gates.G3: Host private-context policy unassessed; no outbound tool added
gates.G4: Bounded POSIX file containment; same-user arbitrary attackers not covered
gates.G5: File/byte limits; no provider or model routing
gates.G6: Actual person/operator owns consent and decisions; record is not authority

evidence: Local software tests only; human usefulness and transfer unrun
